bagPolicy.summary: Citizens Bank Park enforces a clear bag policy to ensure fan safety and expedite entry. Only specific types and sizes of bags are allowed, and all bags are subject to search.
allowed: Clear Bags (Plastic, vinyl or PVC) no larger than 12” x 6” x 12”
Small Clutch Bags/Wallets no larger than 6.5” x 4.5”
Seat cushions without pockets, zippers or concealable areas no larger than 18” wide
prohibited: Luggage, computer bags, camera bags, briefcases, fanny packs, cinch bags
bagPolicy.note: Diaper bags and medical bags are exceptions.

parking.note: Citizens Bank Park is in the South Philadelphia Sports Complex with shared stadium lots (also serving Lincoln Financial Field and the Wells Fargo Center) plus the Citizens Bank Park garages. Prepaid parking is cheaper than drive-up, and the SEPTA Broad Street Line's NRG station is a short walk away.

rideshare.note: Use Lot T for rideshare pickup and drop-off. Exit the Third Base Gate and walk along Pattison Avenue toward Broad Street. Request your ride from the designated area.

concessions.note: Citizens Bank Park offers a variety of food and beverage options including local and popular beers at the Beer Garden, classic comfort foods with a modern twist at Bridges Grille, and elevated ballpark classics at Cadillac Diner. Special offerings include a Bacon Wrapped Hot Dog and Pastrami Fry.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: All guests enter Citizens Bank Park on the Main Concourse at street level and there are wheelchair-accessible gates at every bank of turnstiles. Companion Seating is available alongside the spaces for guests using wheelchairs at a maximum 3:1 ratio (3 companions per wheelchair).

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted after you leave the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: For Phillies games, tickets are mobile through the MLB Ballpark app, and every ticket lists the gate closest to your seat. Update and log in to the app before you leave so your tickets are ready to scan; for help, call 215-463-1000. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrances are the First Base Gate, Third Base Gate, and Left Field Gate, plus entrances on Darien Street (East) and Citizens Bank Way (West). The private Suite and Club Entrance is on Pattison Avenue (Home Plate).
